75:1: No, I swear by the Day of Resurrection.
75:2: And I swear by the self-reproaching soul.
75:3: Does man think that We will never bring his bones together?
75:4: Yes, We are capable of arranging his fingertips.
75:5: Rather, man desires to go on sinning ahead of him.
75:6: He asks: 'When is the Day of Resurrection?'
75:8: And when the moon is eclipsed,
75:9: And the sun and the moon are gathered together,
75:10: Man will say on that Day: 'Where is the escape?'
75:11: No, there is no refuge at all.
75:12: To your Rabb, on that Day, is the destination.
75:13: On that Day, man will be informed of what he put forward and what he left behind.
75:14: Rather, man is a witness against his own self,
75:15: Even if he puts forth his excuses.
75:16: Do not move your tongue with it to hasten it.
75:17: Indeed, collecting it and reciting it is upon Us.
75:18: So when We recite it, follow its recitation.
75:19: Then indeed, its explanation is upon Us.
75:20: No, rather you love the fleeting life,
75:22: Faces on that Day will be radiant,
75:24: And faces on that Day will be gloomy,
75:25: Thinking that a back-breaking calamity is about to be done to them.
75:26: No, when it reaches the collarbones,
75:27: And it is said: 'Who is a healer?'
75:28: And he thinks that it is the departure,
75:29: And leg is intertwined with leg,
75:30: To your Rabb, on that Day, is the driving.
75:31: So he neither affirmed the truth nor performed salah,
75:32: But he denied and turned away.
75:33: Then he walked to his family swaggering.
75:34: Woe to you, and then woe!
75:35: Again, woe to you, and then woe!
75:36: Does man think that he will be left neglected?
75:37: Was he not a drop of fluid (nutfah) from emitted semen?
75:38: Then he was an 'alaqah, then He created and proportioned.
75:39: And made of him two pairs, male and female.
75:40: Is not That One able to give life to the dead?
